maps.name: Bright Mesa
maps.blurb: Classic 48×48 duel arena in fixed daylight with balanced mesa starts.

maps.name: Void Rift Crossing
maps.blurb: A diagonal void rift splits the mesa — only two narrow crossings join the halves.

maps.name: Highland Chokes
maps.blurb: Central cliff spine with twin chokes — high ground rewards map control, not water.

maps.name: Crystal Basin
maps.blurb: A glittering crystal bowl at the heart — rich nodes, open flanks, void rim.

maps.name: Ashvein Caldera
maps.blurb: Central caldera vents and a staged tunnel spine — Ashvein's lava bridges reshape the choke mid-game.

maps.name: Random Map
maps.blurb: Seeded 96×96 skirmish with mirrored starts, void rims, and mesa/verdant/crystal biomes.

maps.name: Training Flat
maps.blurb: Open flat grid for drills and input checks.
